# The lab's spider: the trained spider pool, one mind each, every member whole (unlike std_pool.txt, no member is a

# arm coex (2026-10-25): 16 colonies x 10 rounds from std_pool with sight-h2 spiders evolving beside them, handling
# time on, spider evolution held while a round's median colony lost more than 30 ants (spiderhold=30), and each
# round's pool picked by how long its spiders lived beside a colony in a lab box (spiderlab=lab_mid_fruit:150000:2:8).
# Judged in lab_mid_fruit (hand-built ant, 2 spiders, 300k frames, seeds 11-14): spiders and ants both alive in
# 71-80% of samples on 2 seeds, colony intact (~200 ants); the pool before it (sight-h2) died out by 15% every time.
# Breeding genes (NN.body.txt) are not carried here: a lab spider breeds at its species' own bar.
